findings.title: Discounting is running across your catalog
findings.evidence: 3 of your 69 live products are discounted, averaging 18.1% off. When that much of the catalog carries a markdown, shoppers learn to expect one, and full-price orders get harder to win.
findings.week_one: Before a dollar of spend moves, we check which offers your ads should carry, discounts included.

findings.title: No subscribe-and-save path for repeat buyers
findings.evidence: Your storefront runs 69 products with no subscription option we could find on the page. A subscribe-and-save path turns a one-time buyer into an order that repeats without them having to come back and reorder.
findings.week_one: A subscription option is a store decision on your side, and it keeps the customers our campaigns bring in ordering.

findings.title: Your price band is wide and the median sits low
findings.evidence: Your in-stock catalog runs $6 to $528 with a $24 median. With most of your products priced near the bottom of that range, threshold and bundle offers are how an order grows past one item.
findings.week_one: We point spend at the offers and price points that hold blended profit. Bundle and threshold builds on the store are yours to green-light.
